job.job_description:
Generative AI Engineer
This role has been designed as Hybrid with an expectation that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
What you ll do
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
Build and optimize machine learning models for prediction, classification, and automation.
Develop AI applications using Large Language Models and RAG frameworks.
Create and maintain AI agents, chatbots, and intelligent automation workflows.
Fine-tune and evaluate AI models for accuracy, scalability, and performance.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Apply responsible AI practices, including security, privacy, and ethical considerations.
Stay up to date with advancements in AI, machine learning, and cloud-native AI services.
What you need to bring
2 4 years of experience in AI/ML, Data Science, or Software Engineering.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and model development.
Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI APIs.
Understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, and embeddings.
Experience working with REST APIs and microservices.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
Preferred: experience with AI agents, cloud platforms, MLOps, NLP, Computer Vision, or Conversational AI.
A degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field; certifications are a plus.
Additional Skills:
Cloud Architectures, Cross Domain Knowledge, Design Thinking, Development Fundamentals, DevOps, Distributed Computing, Microservices Fluency, Full Stack Development, Security-First Mindset, Solutions Design, Testing Automation, User Experience (UX)
What We Can Offer You:
Health Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
Personal Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
Lets Stay Connected:
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.
